Settings are read once at startup by `src/config.ts`. Each value comes from, in
order of precedence:

1. an environment variable,
2. the YAML file named by `APP_CONFIG` (default `config/app.yaml`),

args.title: Add YAML keys to the configuration reference
args.body:
File: docs/CONFIG.md

The configuration reference currently provides environment variable names but does not specify the corresponding YAML keys used in the configuration file. Adding a column that lists the YAML keys alongside each variable will clarify the mapping and assist users in configuring the application correctly.
